svg.title: This origin estimate controls the zero-, one- and two-field matrices of the regularizing ninth power. Write P = μ2(A+μ2I)−1, where A is the sector Gram matrix, and U = P 3. The preceding estimate applies to U at zero field. If C3 bounds its three ordinary film matrices, the corresponding three matrices of U3 have trace-ideal price at most 20C2 3Q. In fact every zero-field product has an unmarked U, every first-field product has two, and every second-field product has at least one. Put one unmarked factor in the trace ideal and the other two in operator norm. The second-field Leibniz formula has three placements of a second-field matrix and six ordered placements of two first-field matrices. Their sum and the lower orders are covered by 20. This never converts an L4-dimensional bound into a trace bound. The regularizer is μ2P 9, so its price is μ2B, where B = 20C2 3Q.
